A '''battle group''' of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]]. The battle group consisted of a [[Unidentified clone scout battalion|battalion]] of [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]] from the [[501st Legion]], a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], and aerial cavalry from the [[7th Aleena Reconnaissance Regiment]].<ref name="EGTW Cut 9" /> [[Bogey Squad]] was part of the battle group.<ref name="Note" />
